title: Choose your player layout
description: Use desktop side docks or compact mobile header/footer placement while browsing both vaults.

steps.caption: 1. Start Night Sessions. Playback remains available as you navigate.
2. Choose Right dock to keep the player beside the content.

mobile.caption: 2. Choose Header for a compact player above the page.

steps.caption: 3. Open Samples. Your current Dub Pack continues playing independently of the page.
4. Choose Footer to return to a horizontal player beneath the page.
5. Pop out keeps the essential controls in a small floating player.

mobile.caption: 5. Minimized keeps the essential controls in a small floating player.
